register.labelZh: TOUCH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: touch on 可以表示簡短提及一個構思；touch off 則可以表示引發一件事情或反應。；touch off 表示某事引發更大的事件；touch up 則表示作出小型修補或改善。；touch somebody for 某個金額可以表示向該人開口要錢或借錢。；touch somebody up 表示非禮某人；touch something up 則表示修補或改善某件物品。
register.summaryEn: Touch on can describe briefly mentioning an idea, while touch off can describe starting an event or reaction. Touch off describes something that starts a larger event. Touch up describes small repairs or improvements. Touch somebody for an amount of money can describe asking that person to give or lend you the money. Touch somebody up refers to unwanted sexual touching, while touch something up refers to improving or repairing a thing.
